Cell subgroups

Source: R/data.R
subgroups.Rd

Example output of compute.deconvolution.analysis(), computed on deconv_bulk with compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconv_bulk, corr = 0.7).

Usage

subgroups

Format

A list with 7 elements: "Deconvolution matrix", "Deconvolution subgroups per cell types", "Deconvolution subgroups composition", "Discarded features with high number of zeros", "Discarded features with low variance", "Discarded cell types" and "Cell groups" (NULL here: no cell_groups were given).

Examples

data(subgroups)
subgroups[[1]]
